says: Today's CI: the plants in workflow-lint.test.ts found a job's step by its place in the list (`w.jobs.test.steps[2]`), so each new step in a job moved the plants' numbers and every such line had to be edited again by hand.
proof: On 2026-11-14 three commits rewrote those lookups: e6b5068f4 (T967, 9 lines with a `steps[N]` lookup removed and 9 added), af9e494f2 (pull request 1242, 12 and 12) and 5d7dcbb42 on pull request 1243 (one apt step added to the test job, 13 and 13). `grep -c 'steps\[' .github/ci/workflow-lint.test.ts` gave 83 at 5d7dcbb42 and 93 at af9e494f2. A plant at a stale number edits the wrong step and can still turn the lint red, for another reason, so a wrong number stays hidden.
cost: Each step added to a job costs a hand renumbering of the plants, and a plant that lands on the wrong step stops guarding its law without a red test.
